descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S05 Nursing Home dashboard has the two tabs and the same design as Hospital's; Hospital has no tabs

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 In Nursing Home the dashboard comes with 'Today's Visits' and 'All Residents' tabs (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B) (TFA-92598 AC 2; TFA-92598 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture: one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident (In Today by default)

When Open the Hospital dashboard from the list; go back, switch to Nursing Home, open its dashboard from the bottom nav

Then Both screens are 'Rounding Dashboard' with the same four tiles and the same patient-row shape (name, location, pending task count, status). The Nursing Home one also offers 'Today's Visits' and 'All Residents' tabs. The Hospital one has no tabs and no In Today control (attendance is Nursing Home only, TFA-92587 AC 7). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. Hospital checkpoint: mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard', 'Total', 'tasks pending' (the prototype's row line) and the patient; mustNotContain the resident, 'button "Today's Visits"', 'button "All Residents"' and 'In Today'. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
